entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: Individual decision-makers: president, PM, ministers, party leaders

attributes.name: bloc_affiliation
attributes.description: Political bloc the person belongs to

entity_types.selection_rule: Named individuals whose decisions (49.3, censure, emergency powers, candidacy) causally affect the forecast

entity_types.name: Government
entity_types.description: Executive bodies, ministries and state institutions of France
entity_types.selection_rule: State organs and institutions with formal decision or adjudication power (legislature, ministries, courts, EU bodies)

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Non-state actors: insurers, banks, central bank, rating agencies
entity_types.selection_rule: Real non-state organizations whose actions (loss estimates, ratings, market commentary) shift fiscal/market outcomes

entity_types.name: PoliticalParty
entity_types.description: Parties and electoral blocs competing in the 2027 election
entity_types.selection_rule: Named parties or coalitions whose votes decide censure and whose candidates contest April 2027
anti_examples: 'The left' as an abstract category without a named bloc

entity_types.name: FiscalInstrument
entity_types.description: Trackable fiscal objects: budget bills, deficit procedures, deficit targets

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: budget bill / EDP / deficit target / special law

entity_types.selection_rule: Concrete fiscal texts, procedures or numeric targets whose resolution the forecast scores
anti_examples: General debt levels without an attached instrument

entity_types.name: PublicOrderEvent
entity_types.description: Riot episodes, curfews and emergency-measure declarations

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: riot / curfew / state of emergency / protest

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Scale indicators: arrests, looted shops, insured losses

examples: 1955 State of Emergency Act declaration option
entity_types.selection_rule: Dated episodes or measures of unrest and public-order response

entity_types.name: MarketAsset
entity_types.description: Traded assets and market series the forecast prices

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: sovereign bond / equity index / bank stock

entity_types.selection_rule: Specific priceable series with objective resolution criteria in the forecast

entity_types.name: InformationSource
entity_types.description: Passive sources: pollsters, media, statistical publishers cited as evidence

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: pollster / media / statistical agency / rating note

entity_types.selection_rule: Entities that only report, poll or estimate; they do not decide outcomes
entity_types.role_class_note: context tier; never a simulated decision agent

edge_types.name: OPPOSES
edge_types.direction_semantics: source opposes / moves against target (e.g., NFP tables censure against the Government)

edge_types.name: ALLY_OF
edge_types.description: Support or tacit abstention alignment between actors
edge_types.direction_semantics: source supports or abstains to benefit target

edge_types.name: REGULATES
edge_types.description: Institutional oversight: EU EDP, constitutional review, ratings
edge_types.direction_semantics: source oversees, rules on or disciplines target (Commission regulates France's deficit path)

edge_types.name: TRIGGERS
edge_types.description: Causal trigger: unrest or votes precipitating political/market moves
edge_types.direction_semantics: source event precipitates change in target (riots trigger spread widening, curfews trigger de-escalation)

edge_types.name: CAUSES
edge_types.description: Causal mechanism: fiscal slippage or censure driving outcomes
edge_types.direction_semantics: source causally produces change in target (budget slippage causes spread widening; censure causes government fall)

edge_types.name: INFLUENCES
edge_types.description: General influence of actors on polls, markets or events
edge_types.direction_semantics: source shapes target's standing or level (Le Pen influences RN polling; Moody's influences OAT pricing)

edge_types.name: COMPETES_WITH
edge_types.description: Electoral competition between parties or candidates

attributes.name: arena
attributes.description: presidential first round / runoff / budget vote

edge_types.direction_semantics: source contests the same electorate or vote as target

edge_types.name: DEPENDS_ON
edge_types.description: Dependency: government survival or market pricing on other actors

attributes.name: criticality
attributes.description: high/medium/low — how essential the dependency is

attributes.name: fallback
attributes.description: Option if dependency fails (49.3, special law)

edge_types.direction_semantics: source's survival or enactment depends on target's votes or support (Lecornu cabinet depends on PS abstention)

edge_types.name: REPORTS_ON
edge_types.description: Information sources reporting on actors, events or instruments
edge_types.direction_semantics: source publishes claims about target; no causal agency attributed

edge_types.name: CONSTRAINS
edge_types.description: Legal or procedural constraint on outcomes

attributes.name: mechanism
attributes.description: constitutional article / organic law / EDP rule

edge_types.direction_semantics: source legally or procedurally restricts target's options (constitution constrains election postponement; 289-vote rule constrains censure)

analysis_summary: 该预测问题横跨法国财政（PLF 2027、49.3、EDP、赤字5.5%阈值）、政府存续（不信任动议289票门槛、技术官僚内阁）、公共秩序（2026年10月骚乱及再发风险）、选举（2027年4月首轮，RN领先32.5-38%）与市场（OAT-Bund利差150.8bps、CAC 40、银行评级）五个相互传导的维度。本体以 seed 类型 Person/Government/Organization 为骨架，新增 PoliticalParty（关键少数派系算术：RN 122席、PS弃权20票边际）、FiscalInstrument（预算案与EDP等可判定客体）、PublicOrderEvent（骚乱这一摆动变量）、MarketAsset（可定价的市场序列）、InformationSource（民调机构/媒体为 tier-3 被动来源）。边类型复用 OPPOSES/ALLY_OF/REGULATES/COMPETES_WITH/DEPENDS_ON 并新增 TRIGGERS/CAUSES/CONSTRAINS 因果与治理边，携带 sign/lag/strength 属性以刻画骚乱→安全显著性→RN得票、赤字滑移→利差走阔等传导链，服务多智能体推演。
